name: Don't Starve Together
description: Klei's co-op wilderness survival. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous); requires a free Klei cluster token.

install.content:
#!/bin/sh
# The DST binary must run with cwd inside its bin directory; this wrapper also
# keeps cluster data inside the server directory so panel backups include it.
ROOT="$(pwd)"
mkdir -p "$ROOT/klei/DoNotStarveTogether/$1"
if [ -x bin64/dontstarve_dedicated_server_nullrenderer_x64 ]; then
  cd bin64 && exec ./dontstarve_dedicated_server_nullrenderer_x64 -console -persistent_storage_root "$ROOT/klei" -cluster "$1" -shard Master
fi
cd bin && exec ./dontstarve_dedicated_server_nullrenderer -console -persistent_storage_root "$ROOT/klei" -cluster "$1" -shard Master

variables.label: Cluster name
variables.description: Folder name of the cluster under klei/DoNotStarveTogether/.

variables.label: Game port (UDP)
variables.description: Must match server_port in the shard's server.ini (default 10999).

notes: REQUIRED: create a cluster token at accounts.klei.com (Games > Don't Starve Together > Game Servers) and save it to klei/DoNotStarveTogether/<cluster>/cluster_token.txt via the file manager, then restart. Cluster settings live in cluster.ini, world settings in Master/leveldataoverride.lua; a Caves world needs a second shard. The stop command c_shutdown() saves the world before exiting.
